events.title: Judiciary Act Passed by U.S. Congress
events.description: The U.S. Congress passed the Judiciary Act of 1789, which established the structure of the federal court system, including the Supreme Court with six justices, thirteen district courts, and three circuit courts. President George Washington signed it into law on September 24, and it also created the office of the Attorney General.
events.significance: Laid the foundation of the American federal judiciary and shaped the balance of power between federal and state courts.

events.title: First Powered Airship Flight by Henri Giffard
events.description: French engineer Henri Giffard flew a steam-powered airship about 27 kilometers from Paris to Trappes, reaching a speed of roughly 8 km/h. It was the first powered, controlled lighter-than-air flight.
events.significance: Demonstrated that dirigible flight was feasible and paved the way for later airships and aviation development.

events.title: Black Friday Gold Panic
events.description: Financiers Jay Gould and James Fisk attempted to corner the U.S. gold market, driving the price of gold sharply upward. The scheme collapsed when the U.S. Treasury released gold into the market, causing a sudden crash and widespread financial ruin.
events.significance: Exposed the vulnerability of financial markets to manipulation and political corruption during the Gilded Age.

events.title: Eisenhower Sends Federal Troops to Little Rock
events.description: President Dwight D. Eisenhower ordered the 101st Airborne Division to Little Rock, Arkansas, and federalized the Arkansas National Guard to enforce desegregation and protect nine Black students entering Central High School.
events.significance: Showed federal willingness to enforce court-ordered school desegregation over state resistance and became a landmark moment in the civil rights movement.

events.title: USS Enterprise Launched
events.description: The USS Enterprise (CVN-65), the world's first nuclear-powered aircraft carrier, was launched at Newport News, Virginia.
events.significance: Marked a major leap in naval technology, providing carriers with nearly unlimited range and transforming naval power projection.
